description.en-US: The F-Droid repository of Tratto, a handwriting notes app for Android tablets with a stylus. This is the full build, with handwriting transcription, handwritten math, Google Drive and Google Docs.

NonFreeDep.en-US: Uses Google ML Kit (on-device handwriting recognition) and Google Play services (Google Drive sign-in).
NonFreeDep.it-IT: Usa Google ML Kit (riconoscimento della scrittura sul tablet) e Google Play services (accesso a Google Drive).

NonFreeNet.en-US: Optional backup to Google Drive; the handwriting model is downloaded once from Google.
NonFreeNet.it-IT: Backup facoltativo su Google Drive; il modello per la scrittura si scarica una volta da Google.
